translation.name: Di Nyoo Testiment eena Bileez Kriol
translation.englishName: New Testament in Belize Kriol English (BH:bzj:Belize Kriol English)

content: Now, eech hai prees geh pik fahn monks ih oan peepl, fi goh fronta Gaad fi dehn, ahn aafa sakrifais fi di peepl dehn sin dehn, ahn fi kehr dehn gif tu Gaad.
Ahn laik how di hai prees ihself week eena lata wayz, ih ku deel wid dehn eena wahn jentl way, wen dehn mek mistayk ahn noh noa weh dehn di du.
Sayka weh hihn week, hihn haftu aafa sakrifais tu Gaad fi fi hihn oan sin dehn, plos fi di peepl dehn sin.
Bot nobadi kyaahn geh di aana fi bee wahn hai prees jos kaa dehn waahn; da Gaad haftu pik hihn speshal fi dis werk, jos laik how ih mi pik Ayron.
Sayhn way, Krais neva aana fi hihn oanself ahn mek ihself bee no hai prees, bot da Gaad weh tel ahn seh,

content.text: tudeh Ai kohn fi bee yu Faada.”

content: Ahn eena wahn nada paat a di Skripcha, ih seh tu,

content.text: “Yoo da wahn prees fareva ahn eva,
eena di sayhn way how Melkizidek

content: Wen Jeezas mi-di liv dong ya pahn ert, ih krai owt tu Gaad haad-wan wid livin aiywaata ahn bayg ahn fi sayv ahn fahn det. Ahn sayka weh Jeezas mi hombl ihself ahn obay Gaad, Gaad yehr ih pryaaz.
Soh, eevn doa Jeezas da-mi Gaad Son, ih mi haftu laan fi obay chroo di ting dehn weh ih mi sofa.
Ahn soh wen Jeezas kohn fi bee evriting weh ih sopoas tu bee, chroo hihn, aal dehn wan weh obay Gaad ku geh sayv ahn soh liv fareva.
Dat da wai Gaad pik hihn fi bee wahn hai prees laik Melkizidek.
Groa op eena unu laanina Gaad chroot
Lata ting deh bowt dis sobjek weh wi wuda waahn seh, bot ih haad fi eksplayn kaa unu sloa.

Di taim don kohn wen unu shuda staat fi teech ada peepl, bot unu haftu ga sohnbadi fi teech unu agen di fos lesn dehn weh unu mi laan bowt Gaad mesij. Unu da laik lee pikni weh haftu jrink jos milk, kaa unu noh redi yet fi di salid food.
Enibadi weh jrink milk da stil pikni, ahn dehn noh noa notn bowt weh rait ahn weh rang.
Now salid food da fi peepl weh don groa op, peepl weh ga ekspeeryens eena how fi tel weh da di difrens bitween gud ahn eevl.

footnotes.text: Ayron da-mi Moaziz breda. Gaad mi pik hihn fi bee prees fi di peepl a Izrel (Eksodos 28:1).
Melkizidek da-mi wahn prees ahn king weh mi liv bifoa Ayron, eena di taim a Aybraham (Jenisiz 14:17-24).
